description: Branch B Decimal fidelity, deciding variants: equal values of different scale and scale-28 low values. DT holds a Decimal(28,4), b Decimal(28,20) and c Decimal(28,28) made through ADO DDL. Asks the stored values and VarType, a = b, a + b, a * b, a - b, c, c + c, c * 1, CStr(c), CDbl(c), WHERE a = b, WHERE c > 0, Sum(c) and Sum(a) (Field.Type, Size and Value of each result). Follow-up probe (status F) for Branch B, SQL-EQ-02; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

SELECT id, a = b AS eq, a + b AS s, a * b AS m, a - b AS d FROM DT

SELECT id FROM DT WHERE a = b
